requirements_summary.title: Scan Issues
requirements_summary.problem: ghbot can scan repositories for metadata (info) and security findings (security), but has no command for open issue tracking across an owner's repositories.
requirements_summary.goal: Add an `issues` subcommand backed by a new IssuesRepoProcessor reporting, per repository, `open_issue_count` (pull requests excluded) and `open_issues` — an ordered list of {number, title, labels} records.
requirements_summary.output: plain: per-repo `#<number> <description>` lines (with --labels, `+`-prefixed labels). table: one row per issue (Repository | # | Description; with --labels a comma-separated Labels column). json: repositories[] each with open_issue_count and issues[]; with --labels each issue carries a labels array. PRs excluded everywhere; plain/table omit repos with no open issues; json includes all. None -> N/A in text, null in json.
